294 . Mental math You can use binomial multiplication to multiply numbers without a calculator. Say you need to multiply 13 times 15. Think of 13 as $10 + 3$ and 15 as $10 + 5$ . ⓐ Multiply $(10 + 3) (10 + 5)$ by the FOIL method. ⓑ Multiply $13 \cdot 15$ without using a calculator. ⓒ Which way is easier for you? Why?

295 . Mental math You can use binomial multiplication to multiply numbers without a calculator. Say you need to multiply 18 times 17. Think of 18 as $20 - 2$ and 17 as $20 - 3$ . ⓐ Multiply $(20 - 2) (20 - 3)$ by the FOIL method. ⓑ Multiply $18 \cdot 17$ without using a calculator. ⓒ Which way is easier for you? Why?
296 . Which method do you prefer to use when multiplying two binomials: the Distributive Property, the FOIL method, or the Vertical Method? Why?
